pages.heading: Leafcutter Ant
pages.body: Jungles. Workers gather leaves for underground fungus chambers; a queen is needed to replenish the colony. Harvest Gongylidia near a Shroomlight to avoid

pages.heading: Leafcutter Ant (cont.)
pages.body: angering the ants. Sunlight ruins exposed chambers. Feeding fungus heals and pacifies ants; pupae sometimes dropped from chambers establish new colonies on dirt or grass.
